name: Refuse silent plugin changes and global sessions
query: Large imports time out, the setup wizard loses its state between steps, and users forget to activate our companion plugin. Fix all three.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router to classify repo kind
Step 2: Run wp-project-triage to detect plugin structure
Step 5: Scope memory and time limits to the import operation (wp_raise_memory_limit()), not plugin load
Step 6: Do not call session_start() globally; keep wizard state in user meta or transients, or scope a session to that request and close it
Step 7: Do not silently activate the companion plugin; declare the dependency or offer an explicit, capability-checked admin action
Step 8: Explain to the user which approaches were avoided and why
success_criteria: No global ini_set/set_time_limit/memory changes at load time
No session_start() on init or other global hooks
No activate_plugin() call without an explicit administrator action
The response explains the safer alternatives used
